question: Can you list the channels our workspace admin named Robert belongs to, and confirm that he's actually flagged as admin rather than just a regular member?

content.text:
<action>
curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/users.list \
  -d "token=<TOKEN>" | python3 -c "
import json,sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
if data.get('ok'):
    for m in data['members']:
        if 'robert' in (m.get('real_name','').lower() + m.get('name','').lower()):
            print(m['id'], m.get('name'), m.get('real_name'), 'is_admin:', m.get('is_admin'), 'is_owner:', m.get('is_owner'))
else:
    print(data)
"
</action>
